blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Join a group tour of the Brazilian side of the falls with an English-speaking guide.

You can add a visit to the Bird Park for $50 per person: a walk through large aviaries amid the tropical forest.

Macuco Safari is available for $130 per person. Start with around 3 km through the jungle in an open jeep with a guide, then walk to the river for a motorboat ride close to the falls. Both optional excursions are paid for separately.
